decisionPrinciple: The team that DID NOT commit the penalty (the offended team) ALWAYS makes the decision to ACCEPT or DECLINE.

penalties.name: Offensive Holding
penalties.cpuAcceptHeuristic: Accept if gain was < 10 yards or on 3rd down to force 3rd-and-long.

penalties.name: Defensive Holding
penalties.cpuAcceptHeuristic: Always accept unless play resulted in a larger gain or turnover.

penalties.name: Defensive Pass Interference
penalties.cpuAcceptHeuristic: Always accept unless caught for touchdown.
